source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 28.3 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Genevilla (stage 5) on 2026-10-27, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-10-26. 8 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Genevilla (stage 5) 28, Araia (stage 3) 26, Calahorra (stage 10) 24, Alagón (stage 14) 24, Alcanadre (stage 9) 24, Alfaro (stage 11) 24. FWI anomaly at Genevilla is +4.5 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
